title: Follow up qa-v1-theory-3057e184992900eb9f293abe
behavioral_concerns: follow up: PreviewOffset scroll has no upper bound, allowing ActionDown to increment indefinitely when preview is active

evidence.summary: ActionUp clamps to 0, ActionDown unconditionally increments PreviewOffset without max - asymmetric bounds
Viewport.AtOffset delegates to Clamp/MaxOffset, capping displayed offset to total-height but not bounding stored Model.PreviewOffset; mitigates overflow at render time
Existing test verifies only single increment to 1 and close-reset, never exercising upper-bound or long press

theories.claim: PreviewOffset has no upper bound: Model.Update ActionDown increments m.PreviewOffset indefinitely when m.Preview != nil, while ActionUp is clamped to 0. Rendering is capped downstream by viewport.AtOffset/Clamp, so visible scroll does not overflow, but Model state is unbounded and diverges from displayed offset.
theories.basis: internal/tui/model.go:282-300 shows asymmetric handling: ActionUp does m.PreviewOffset-- with if <0 clamp, ActionDown does unconditional m.PreviewOffset++ with no max check and no access to viewport height/total. No other site clamps PreviewOffset except resets to 0. internal/tui/viewport.go:16-36 caps offset at render time via MaxOffset/Clamp, masking state growth.
theories.verification_surface: internal/tui/model.go:292-294 ActionDown branch, internal/tui/viewport.go:16-37 AtOffset/Clamp/MaxOffset, internal/tui/views.go:53-55 and 614-629 renderFrame offset usage
theories.confirmation_condition: Static inspection finds ActionDown branch for Preview != nil contains only increment with no conditional upper bound or Clamp call and no height-aware limit, whereas ActionUp contains lower-bound clamp; viewport clamping is rendering-only.
theories.refutation_condition: ActionDown branch clamped PreviewOffset to a content-aware maximum (e.g., MaxOffset) or delegated to viewport.Clamp before storing, symmetrically with ActionUp lower bound.
theories.inconclusive_condition: Cannot determine viewport total/height at Model.Update time without reading more context, requiring bounded context expansion beyond textual clamp.
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read-only static inspection of model.go KeyMsg handling and viewport.go AtOffset/Clamp/MaxOffset; cross-reference views.go renderFrame offset usage; no execution, no mutation.
